# B Lab U.S. & Canada

> B Lab U.S. & Canada certifies and supports businesses committed to social and environmental impact through the B Corp certification standard and B Impact Assessment framework.

B Lab U.S. & Canada is the regional hub for B Corp certification in North America, providing certification pathways, community resources, and leadership development for businesses seeking to measure and improve their positive impact. The organization emphasizes racial equity, climate justice, and stakeholder governance as core pillars of the B Corp movement.

## Key Topics

- B Corp Certification
- B Impact Assessment

## Getting Started with B Corp Certification

- [About B Corps](https://usca.bcorporation.net/about-b-corps): Overview of B Corps standards, certification, and social-environmental impact
- [Why Certify?](https://usca.bcorporation.net/why-certify): Explains benefits of B Corp certification for sustainable business practices
- [Who Can Certify?](https://usca.bcorporation.net/who-can-certify): Certification eligibility requirements and business qualification criteria
- [Certification Overview](https://usca.bcorporation.net/certification-overview): Guide to B Corp certification process and B Impact Assessment requirements
- [B Impact Assessment & Getting Started](https://usca.bcorporation.net/b-impact-assessment-getting-started): Getting started guide for B Impact Assessment and impact measurement framework

## Certification Process & Requirements

- [Process & Requirements](https://usca.bcorporation.net/process-requirements-fees): Detailed certification process, requirements, fees, and recertification details
- [Guide to B Corp Recertification](https://usca.bcorporation.net/recertification): Recertification process guide with new 2025 standards and compliance pathways
- [Certification Support Resources](https://usca.bcorporation.net/certification-support-resources): Resource library with templates, best practices, and legal requirements support
- [Brand Guidelines for B Corps](https://usca.bcorporation.net/brand-guidelines-for-b-corps): B Corp brand guidelines, logo usage, and certification communication standards

## Community & Leadership Development

- [For B Corps](https://usca.bcorporation.net/for-b-corps): Community resources for certified B Corps including B Hive and Champions Retreat
- [B Corp Leadership Development](https://usca.bcorporation.net/b-corps-leadership-development): Leadership development programs and BLD events for B Corp community networking
- [Networks](https://usca.bcorporation.net/networks): Community networks including BIPOC, B Locals, and industry-specific groups
- [Champions Retreat 2026](https://usca.bcorporation.net/champions-retreat-2026): Champions Retreat 2026 event announcement and registration information

## Equity & Impact Initiatives

- [Level](https://usca.bcorporation.net/level): Level program supporting BIPOC and women entrepreneurs in B Corp certification
- [Racial Equity](https://usca.bcorporation.net/racial-equity): B Lab's racial equity initiatives supporting marginalized entrepreneurs
- [Climate Justice](https://usca.bcorporation.net/climate-justice): Climate justice framework and B Corps' role in advancing environmental responsibility
- [Stakeholder Economy](https://usca.bcorporation.net/stakeholder-economy): Stakeholder capitalism and B Lab's vision for responsible business governance
